    • Method Detail

      • resolve

        org.codehaus.jackson.JsonNode resolve(org.codehaus.jackson.JsonNode tree,
                                      java.lang.String path)
        Resolves a fragment path and returns a fragment of the given tree.
        Parameters:
        tree - the complete tree of nodes, against which the path will be resolved.
        path - the path that represents a fragment within the document (either slash-delimited or dot-delimited).
        Returns:
        a part/fragment of the document, referred to by the given path
